note: Northwest Florida Water Management District spring area in the Econfina Creek WMA, 1.5 miles north of FL-20 off Blue Springs Road. The camping area (opened January 2021) has its own entrance, the first one on Blue Springs Road, beside the slough to the spring; each site has a picnic pavilion, and a portable toilet is shared. Spring overlook and swimming at the day-use area a short walk away. Site length is not published - primitive sites reached by graded dirt and gravel roads; check the site diagram before bringing a big rig. --Claude
summary: Run by the Northwest Florida Water Management District (ownership local fits). Confirmed free, 3 reservation-only sites, booked on the District's CampLife page; not on the closures list. Booking platform/url now point at CampLife. Not stated: site lengths, the 7-night limit (left), hookups (left). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Login to see availability: CampLife answers 'To see availability for this date range, please log in above', and the District says 'you must first set up a free account' to search. A free government site; a human decides whether AWH's login rule applies here.
No site lengths anywhere (CampLife lists motorhomes and trailers as allowed equipment on all three back-in sites); 23-ft fit is unconfirmed.
